summary: feat(admin-panel): add bulk account disable page
description:
Because:

* Support staff need to disable many accounts at once.

This commit:

* Adds a bulk Account Disable page and admin-server endpoint.
* Adds its own Admin-level permission; it sends no email.
* Shows one summary line of the results, not one row each.
* Reports a failed batch range as having an unknown outcome.

Closes FXA-14910
